## Data 

```{r}
#| label: cleaning and wrangling
#| message: false
#| warning: false

compiled_isotope <- read_csv(here("data", "compiled.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  clean_names() |> # lowercase and underscores in column names
  rename(sample = sample_name, # renaming columns to be shorter 
         delta_d = processed_delta_d,
         delta_d_std = processed_delta_d_stdev,
         delta_o = processed_delta_18o,
         delta_o_std = processed_delta_18o_stdev) |> 
  mutate(date = mdy(date)) # telling r the date format

gradient_tc <- read_csv(here("data", "tc_gradient_data.csv"))

gradient_cc <- read_csv(here("data", "cc_gradient_data.csv"))

gradient_it <- read_csv(here("data", "it_gradient_data.csv"))

metadata <- read_csv(here("data", "metadata.csv"))

site_order <- c("tc_us", "tc_mid", "tc_ds", "tc_1", "tc_15", "tc_2", "tc_3") 

trail_creek_isco <- compiled_isotope |> 
  filter(site %in% c("utc_isco", "tc_isco"))

trail_creek <- compiled_isotope |> 
  filter(site %in% site_order) |> 
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = site_order)) |> 
  arrange(site)

coal_creek <- compiled_isotope |> 
 filter(location %in% c("cc"))

italian_creek <- compiled_isotope |> 
  filter(location == "it")

trail_creek_isco <- read_csv(here("data", "trail_creek_compiled_ISCO.csv")) |> 
  clean_names() |> # lowercase and underscores in column names
  rename(sample = sample_name, # renaming columns to be shorter 
         delta_d = processed_delta_d,
         delta_d_std = processed_delta_d_stdev,
         delta_o = processed_delta_18o,
         delta_o_std = processed_delta_18o_stdev) |> 
  mutate(date = mdy(date))# telling r the date format

utc_isco <- trail_creek_isco |> 
  filter(site == "utc_isco")

tc_isco <- trail_creek_isco |> 
   filter(site == "tc_isco")


# Downstream Trail Creek 
tc_metrics <- read_csv(here("data", "TrailCreek_2026-07-23-15.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |> # reading in data
  clean_names() |> # lowercase and underscores in column names
  rename(date_time = date_time_mdt, # renaming columns to be shorter 
         dp = differential_pressure_k_pa,
         ap = absolute_pressure_k_pa,
         temp = temperature_c,
         water_level = water_level_m,
         bp = barometric_pressure_k_pa) |> 
  mutate(date_time_parsed = mdy_hms(date_time), # telling r the date format
         date = as_date(date_time_parsed)) |> # making a date column 
  group_by(date) |> 
  summarise(avg_dp = mean(dp, na.rm = TRUE), # averaging the data based on the day
            avg_ap = mean(ap, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_temp = mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_water_level = mean(water_level, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_bp = mean(bp, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_readings = n(), # the amount of data it used to average
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(site = "tc") # creating a new column of the site 

# Upstream Trail Creek
utc_metrics <- read_csv(here("data", "UTC_2026-07-23-15.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |> # reading in data
  clean_names() |> # lowercase and underscores in column names
  rename(date_time = date_time_mdt,  # renaming columns to be shorter 
         dp = differential_pressure_k_pa,
         ap = absolute_pressure_k_pa,
         temp = temperature_c,
         water_level = water_level_m,
         bp = barometric_pressure_k_pa) |>
  mutate(date_time_parsed = mdy_hms(date_time), # telling r the date format
         date = as_date(date_time_parsed)) |> # making a date column 
  group_by(date) |> 
  summarise(avg_dp = mean(dp, na.rm = TRUE),  # averaging the data based on the day
            avg_ap = mean(ap, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_temp = mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_water_level = mean(water_level, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_bp = mean(bp, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_readings = n(), # the amount of data it used to average
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(site = "utc") # creating a new column of the site 

tc_utc_metrics <- merge(tc_metrics, utc_metrics, all = TRUE) # merging the tc and utc data 

isco_data <- merge(
  x = tc_utc_metrics, 
  y = compiled_isotope, 
  by.x = c("site", "date"), # columns in tc_utc_data
  by.y = c("location", "date") # matching columns in compiled_isotope
)

discharge_tc_isco <- read_csv(here("data", "discharge_tc_isco.csv"))

discharge_utc_isco <- read_csv(here("data", "discharge_utc_isco.csv"))

discharge_isco <- read_csv(here("data", "isco_discharge_lc.csv"))

hydrograph <- read_csv(here("data", "hydrograph.csv")) |> 
  mutate(date = mdy(date)) # telling r the date format
  
```

## Figures

Figure 1: Time-Series of Line-Conditioned Excess (lc-excess) of ISCO's

```{r}
#| label: figure-1
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 6

ggplot(data = trail_creek_isco, 
       aes(x = date, 
           y = lc_excess, 
           color = site, 
           group = site)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, 
             linetype = "dashed", 
             color = "gray50", 
             size = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, 
             alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("tc_isco" = "dodgerblue", "utc_isco" = "orangered2"),
    labels = c("tc_isco" = "Trail Creek", "utc_isco" = "Upper Trail Creek")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Trail Creek ISCO: Line-Conditioned Excess Over Time",
       subtitle = "Values below 0 indicate potential evaporative enrichment",
       x = "Sampling Date",
       y = "lc-excess (\u2030)",
       color = "Site") +
  ylim(-6,0) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top")

```


Figure 2: Sampling Site and lc-excess (Trail Creek)

```{r}
#| label: figure-2.1-with-equations
#| message: false
#| warning: false


# Standardize names to match your raw data (e.g., tc_us, tc_mid...)
distances_tc <- tibble(
  site = c("tc_us", "tc_mid", "tc_ds", "tc_1", "tc_15", "tc_2", "tc_3"),
  dist_m = c(57.6, 333, 654, 1160, 1620, 2240, 3150)
)

# Add the physical distance column to your data frame
trail_creek_mapped <- trail_creek |> 
  left_join(distances_tc, by = "site")

plot2_1 <- ggplot(data = trail_creek_mapped, aes(x = dist_m, y = lc_excess, color = factor(date), group = date)) + 
  # reference line at 0
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray", linewidth = 0.8) + 
  # linear regression lines using real  distances
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.15) +
  # Equations will now display correct physical slopes (per meter)
  stat_poly_eq(
    aes(label = paste(after_stat(eq.label), after_stat(rr.label), sep = "*\", \"*")),
    formula = y ~ x,
    parse = TRUE,
    label.x = "left", 
    label.y = "bottom", 
    vstep = 0.05, 
    size = 3.0) +
  # Points plotted at exact stream distances
  geom_point(size = 2.0, alpha = 0.8) + 
  labs(
    title = "Trail Creek",
    x = "Sampling Sites",
    y = "lc-excess (\u2030)",
    color = "Sampling Date"
  ) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("2026-06-24" = "royalblue4", "2026-06-30" = "royalblue1", "2026-07-15" = "#809BEB")) +
  # Continuous scale maps site labels directly to their physical meter marks
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(57.6, 333, 654, 1160, 1620, 2240, 3150),
    labels = c("TC-US", "TC-MID", "TC-DS", "BDA-1", "BDA-1.5", "BDA-2", "BDA-3")
  ) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

plot2_1

```

# Figure 3: 
```{r}
#| label: Figure-3
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Spatial variations in Δlc-excess/Δx across sampling dates
# Buildings a look up table of stream distances Trail Creek
distances <- tibble(site = c("TC-P3-US", "TC-P3-mid", "TC-P3-DS", "TC-BDA1",
                             "TC-BDA1.5", "TC-BDA2", "TC-BDA3"),
                    dist_m = c(57.6, 333, 654, 1160, 1620, 2240, 3150)) |> 
  mutate(xmax = dist_m,
         xmin = lag(dist_m, default = 0)) # previous site's distance, 0 for first

# Creating a filtered data frame for lc-excess
gradient_tc_clean <- gradient_tc |>
  select(site, normalized_stream_distance_m, `Δlc-excess/Δx_6-24`, `Δlc-excess/Δx_6-30`, `Δlc-excess/Δx_7-15`) |> 
  pivot_longer( cols = c(`Δlc-excess/Δx_6-24`, `Δlc-excess/Δx_6-30`, `Δlc-excess/Δx_7-15`),
                names_to = "date",
                values_to = "gradient") |>
  mutate(date = case_when(date == "Δlc-excess/Δx_6-24" ~ "2026-06-24",
                          date == "Δlc-excess/Δx_6-30" ~ "2026-06-30",
                          date == "Δlc-excess/Δx_7-15" ~ "2026-07-15"),
         gradient = as.numeric(gradient)) |>
  left_join(distances %>% select(site, xmin, xmax), by = "site") |> 
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = distances$site)) |>
  filter(!is.na(gradient))

# Gradient plot
plot3_1 <- ggplot(gradient_tc_clean) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = 0, ymax = gradient),
            fill = "royalblue4", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "royalblue4", linewidth = 0.4) +
  ylim(-4,4) +
  facet_wrap(~ date, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = distances$dist_m,
    labels = distances$site) +
  labs(title = "Trail Creek",
       x = "Normalized stream distance (m)",
       y = expression(paste(Delta, "lc-excess / ", Delta, "x ((\u2030)/km)"))) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8))
plot3_1
```

## Figure 4

```{r}

# averaging the lc-excess and including standard error
delta_summary <- trail_creek |>
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = site_order)) |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(
    mean_lc = mean(lc_excess, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_lc = sd(lc_excess, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop")

# creating a plot to show the mean lc-excess of each site (coal creek)
plot4_1 <- ggplot(delta_summary, aes(x = site, y = mean_lc)) +
  geom_col(fill = "royalblue4", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_lc - se_lc, ymax = mean_lc + se_lc),
                width = 0.3,
                color = "black") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("tc_1" = "BDA-1", "tc_15" = "BDA-1.5", 
                              "tc_2" = "BDA-2", "tc_3" = "BDA-3", 
                              "tc_ds" = "TC-DS", "tc_mid" = "TC-MID", 
                              "tc_us" = "TC-US")) +
  ylim(-4.8, 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Trail Creek",
       x = "Sampling Site",
       y = "Mean lc-excess (\u2030)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none") # Safely removes the now-empty legend

plot4_1

                width = 0.3, color = "black") + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("coal_1" = "CC-1", "coal_2" = "CC-2", "coal_3" = "CC-3", "coal_4" = "CC-4", "coal_5" = "CC-5", "coal_6" = "CC-6")) + 
   ylim(-4.8, 3) +

        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 9),

# creating a plot to show the mean lc-excess of each site (italian creek)
plot4_3 <- ggplot(delta_summary_it, aes(x = site, y = mean_lc, fill = site)) +
  geom_col(fill = "royalblue4", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_lc - se_lc, ymax = mean_lc + se_lc),
                width = 0.3, color = "black") + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("italian_1" = "IT-1", "italian_2" = "IT-2", "italian_3" = "IT-3", "italian_4" = "IT-4", "italian_5" = "IT-5")) +
   ylim(-4.8, 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Italian Creek (control)",
       x = "Sampling Site",
       y = "Mean lc-excess (\u2030)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.spacing.x = unit(0.2, "cm"))

plot4_3
```

```{r}
#| label: hydrograph-with-overlay
#| message: false
#| warning: false


slope <- 0.01333
intercept <- 0.08

ggplot() +
  # hydrograph
  geom_line(data = hydrograph, 
            aes(x = date, y = discharge, color = site, group = site),
            linewidth = 1) +
  # isco_data overlay
  geom_point(data = isco_data, 
             aes(x = date, y = (lc_excess * slope) + intercept, color = site, group = site), 
             shape = 20, # Solid point 
             size = 2.5, # Large enough to see clearly
             alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("tc" = "dodgerblue", "utc" = "orangered2"),
    labels = c("tc" = "Trail Creek", "utc" = "Upper Trail Creek")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Discharge (cfs)",
    limits = c(0, 0.16),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. - intercept) / slope, name = "LC-Excess (\u2030)")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Discharge and LC-Excess over time",
       subtitle = "Lines show discharge; points show lc-excess samples",
       x = "Date",
       color = "Site") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  # cleans up the legend box so it displays both a line and a triangle together
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = c(20, 20), linetype = c(1, 1))))
```

```{r}
plot6_1


gradient_cum_tc <- gradient_tc |> 
  select(site, cumulative_dams,
         `Δlc-excess/Δcum_dam_length_6-24`, `Δlc-excess/Δcum_dam_length_6-30`, `Δlc-excess/Δcum_dam_length_7-15`) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Δlc-excess/Δcum_dam_length_6-24`, `Δlc-excess/Δcum_dam_length_6-30`, `Δlc-excess/Δcum_dam_length_7-15`),
    names_to = "date",
    values_to = "gradient"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    date = case_when(
      date == "Δlc-excess/Δcum_dam_length_6-24" ~ "2026-06-24",
      date == "Δlc-excess/Δcum_dam_length_6-30" ~ "2026-06-30",
      date == "Δlc-excess/Δcum_dam_length_7-15" ~ "2026-07-15"
    ),
    gradient = as.numeric(gradient),
    cumulative_dams = as.numeric(cumulative_dams),
    site = factor(site, levels = c("TC-P3-US", "TC-P3-mid", "TC-P3-DS",
                                    "TC-BDA1", "TC-BDA1.5", "TC-BDA2", "TC-BDA3"))
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(gradient))


plot6_2 <- ggplot(gradient_cum_tc, aes(x = site, y = gradient)) + # Removed fill = site
  geom_col(fill = "royalblue4", color = "black", width = 0.7) +   # Added fill = "royalblue4"
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ date, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) {
    lookup <- setNames(gradient_cum_tc$cumulative_dams, gradient_cum_tc$site)
    lookup[x]
  }) +
    ylim(-0.7, 0.3) +
  labs(title = "Trail Creek", 
    x = "Cumulative dam count",
    y = expression(Delta * "lc-excess/" * Delta * "cumulative dam count (" * "\u2030" * ")/m")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray85", color = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none" # Removes the now empty legend box
  )

plot6_2


gradient_cum_cc <- gradient_cc |>
```
